Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.

A small server patch was released at 09:15 (UTC+0) / 02:15 AM (PDT). This server patch will address the following issues: 

1. Fixed an issue with the Cinematic Battle Rank where all of the main hero is being shown as Captain America except for your own main hero. (This is #4 on the 3.5 Known Issue list) 
2. Fixed an issue wherein extra Boost Points will disappear when more are acquired after the maximum point
3.  Fixed an issue with Valkyrie's Skill, Step of the Goddess, where it's continuously activated without cooldown when using Auto Play+

In order to download the patch, you will need to restart your device. 

Thank You
